title: Ninths in Mexico and with Jack Carey; keeping in practice
summary: He played ninths in Mexico in 1926 but not with Jack Carey; he has not touched his banjo in a year due to illness.

story.theme_name: Banjo, guitar and the rhythm section: instruments and players

blocks.x: Ask him if he played ninths in Mexico, when he was in Mexico. I want to get this straight.
So did you play ninths when you were in Mexico? Yeah. Yeah. Well that's 20- That was 1926 I was right there. Yeah. Okay.
Ask him if he played ninths with Jack Carey.
No. No. I didn't know him. I was making but I didn't know what there was. Oh I see. Yeah. I see. See I just forgot a whole lot too, you see.
didn't play no music, you know.
And that made me stop studying.

I always run over my methods and run over old songs I used to have. music to keep in practice, you know. And now since I've been sick I ain't had my hand on my banjo for about a year now, you know. Well ask him- Mm-hm.
